description:
At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources.  We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career.
 
 ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future. 

 
 
 Grid and Market Solutions (GMS) Application Developer role expects knowledge and experience in full stack development who can design, code, test, document, and maintain applications to meet ERCOT business requirements for suite of Electric Power Grid Applications. The suite includes Resource Integration and Ongoing Operations (RIOO) system and Net Dependable Capability and Reactive Capability (NDCRC) web applications. Adhere to software development life cycle (SDLC) processes that include full stack development, performing testing and validation of Application to deliver quality software to customers. Works closely with customers, business area subject matter experts, team members and other internal technical teams to design, develop and maintain complex ERCOT applications in support of market needs and internal corporate requirements.  Uses toolsets that adhere to the frameworks of the technical stack used across the GMS division and ensures that products and solutions comply with the organization’s architectural standards 
 
 JOB DUTIES 
 Broadly applies principles, theories and concepts related to the profession. A seasoned, experienced professional with an in-depth/full understanding of area of specialization.
 May provide recommendations regarding issues outside the bounds of defined procedures and practices. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions.
 Wide latitude for decisions within assignments, programs, and projects; impact is generally limited to the project or department.
 Acts as a resource to advise and may at times a lead the work of lower-level professional and/or support employees.  Generally, represents the department on projects and may perform in a project leadership role.
 
 ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES 
 Performs all work according to applicable rules and regulations, including regulatory requirements and organizational policies and procedures.
 Works closely with business users and internal stakeholders to gather, review, and understand functional and non-functional requirements, proposing design improvements where appropriate.
 Designs, develops, tests, and maintains web-based applications using front-end and/or back-end technologies.
 Participates in requirements, design, and architecture review discussions with business users and technical teams.
 Develops and manages source code using Atlassian Bitbucket source control tools.
 Adheres to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards and change management processes for all software releases.
 Understands and follows GMS application release processes and best practices to deliver software changes seamlessly.
 Participates in interdepartmental meetings and presents software design, implementation details, and application enhancements.
 Analyzes, troubleshoots, and resolves application issues by performing root cause analysis and delivering software solutions.
 Participates in developing design specifications that comply with ERCOT architectural standards and blueprints.
 Researches, evaluates, and incorporates new technologies and tools to improve product development and engineering efficiency.
 Resolves customer issues and responds to enhancement requests.
 Assists in developing product user manuals and technical documentation.
 Works closely with GMS Production Support and other teams to provide technical support for supported applications.
 Automates software development processes using CI/CD tools such as Bitbucket, Maven, and Jenkins.
 Assists in developing tools, processes, and procedures that improve software development and organizational efficiency.
 Leverages AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, GPT, and Claude to accelerate software development, testing, code quality, and engineering productivity.
 Works with data sets and data pipelines, including Airflow and Databricks, and analyzes third-party software security vulnerabilities to implement security patches.
 Performs code reviews and promotes coding standards, best practices, and design patterns.
 Performs manual and automated unit, regression, and integration testing using appropriate testing frameworks.
 Works closely with project management teams to ensure successful delivery of application changes through testing and production deployment.
 Collaborates with project managers, architects, developers, usability engineers, business users, market participants, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure quality product delivery.
 Assists in providing development metrics, code statistics, and implementation of standardized development methodologies.
 Ensures products and solutions comply with organizational architectural standards.
 Focuses on application and system design while providing technical guidance and mentoring to team members.
 Partners with technical leads to define solutions for complex business problems and enforce engineering standards.
 Optimizes applications, leads root cause analysis for production issues, and drives automation initiatives.
 Organizes and coordinates application planning, design, architecture, development, testing, and integration activities.
 Advises management on technical direction and development goals for the GMS Technology Development team.
 Assists with project planning and delivery across all phases of application development.
 Serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), advising, mentoring, and guiding team members and cross-functional stakeholders.
 Communicates effectively through strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Works on moderately complex issues requiring in-depth analysis and creative problem-solving.
 
 Level Lead (In Addition to Senior) 
 Provides strategic technical leadership and cross-team coordination.
 Establishes engineering standards, architectural patterns, and evaluates emerging technologies.
 Serves as the primary technical partner for Business/Product Owners, translating strategic goals into technical roadmaps.
 Drives a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and engineering best practices across multiple teams.
 Assists engineering teams in resolving complex technical challenges and delivering effective solutions.
 Mentors senior developers in software engineering best practices, object-oriented design, design patterns, and application frameworks.
 Maintains expert knowledge of ERCOT Nodal Protocols, PUCT rulings, NERC Reliability Standards, and CIP requirements, and mentors staff on regulatory compliance.
 
 All Levels -- Preferred SKILLS
 Messaging Services: Tibco JMS, AMQ, KAFKA
 Experience with CIM/XML model-based tools.
 Power industry experience in grid and market arena preferably with software vendors or ISO/utilities.
 AI: Proficiency in Python, knowledge in ML fundamentals, PyTorch/TensorFlow frameworks, experience with deep learning models, hands-on experience with LLM’s, prompt engineering and RAG architecture/frameworks.
 Data Pipelines: Hands-on experience with data pipelines and large-scale data processing.
 
 SKILL REQUIREMENTS
 Back-End : Java (17+), Spring Boot/Spring MVC.
 Front-End : Angular (v12+, RxJS, NGRX, Signal store/NGRX Signals) or React (Hooks, Context API/Redux), TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3/SASS.
 Scripting Language : Python, Shell Scripting
 Database : Experience with relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and understanding of NoSQL (MongoDB or Cassandra).
 APIs : RESTful API design, JSON, and OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
 Tools : Git (GitHub/Bitbucket), Maven, and IDEs (IntelliJ, VS Code), Ansible for deployments.
 Operating Systems : Windows, Linux.
 Containerization:   Docker  (building images, managing containers, Docker Compose).
 Cloud Technologies: Experience with Azure/AWS
 Experience with advanced usage of AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, GPT and Claude LLMs for architectural brainstorming, debugging, software development, refactoring, automated unit and integration testing 
 Experience with advanced prompt engineering to ensure reliable AI responses 
 Knowledge in processing datasets using Databricks and Airflow 
 
 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
 Senior Level Engineer - Requires minimum 5 years related work experience in excess of degree requirements
 Lead Level Engineer - Requires minimum 8 years related work experience in excess of degree requirements
 
 Salary and level will be based on overall experience as determined by ERCOT.
 
 EDUCATION
 Bachelor's Degree: Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field (Required)
 Master's Degree: Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field (Preferred)
 or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge to a major in such fields is required
 
 WORK LOCATION – Taylor, TX:
 Employees will be required to be on-site in Taylor, TX at a minimum of 2 days per week, or more, as needed based on the business needs as determined by management
 On-site schedules are flexible or may be rotated based on business needs as determined by the Manager
 Remote work is required to be performed from your Texas residence.  
 Employees may opt to work on-site more than required or 100% of the time
 
 The foregoing description reflects the minimum qualifications and the essential functions of the position that must be performed proficiently with or without reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities.  It is not an exhaustive list of the duties expected to be performed, and management may, at its discretion, revise or require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned.  This job description is not intended to create a contract of employment with ERCOT.  Both ERCOT and the employee may exercise their employment-at-will rights at any time. #LI-Hybrid, #LI-MH1
 
 ERCOT is firmly committed to equal employment for all qualified persons without regard to race, sex, medical condition, religion, age, creed, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, ancestry, veteran status, genetic information or any other protected category under federal, state or local law. 
 
 
 
 Expected Salary Range:
$145,000 - $200,000
